description: A Stacking ensemble learning model in which four heterogeneous individual learners—Support Vector Machine, Decision Tree, Logistic Regression, and Linear Discriminant Analysis—serve as base classifiers.
title: Stacking ensemble learning for educational achievement prediction

description: Because CSCL lacks shared descriptors for phenomena and analytic approaches, the article recommends standardized descriptors within a community taxonomy.
title: Standardized taxonomy descriptors for CSCL phenomena and analytic approaches

description: The study employed a standardized zero-shot evaluation protocol in which all 10 LLMs completed five independent runs across all 300 examination statements through publicly available web interfaces rather than APIs, \"reflecting the predominant interaction patterns of clinical and educational end user
title: Standardized zero-shot multi-run web-interface evaluation protocol for LLMs on high-stakes examinations

description: The review organizes variation in engagement measurement around assumptions about temporality: engagement can be treated as a momentary, transient state of immersion in an activity, assessed by observations and experience sampling, or as a relatively stable tendency to behave in certain ways, assess
title: State–trait temporality framework for child engagement measurement

description: Stealth assessment is an approach in which measurement of a skill is woven into gameplay so that students' ordinary choices generate the assessment data without them knowing they are being assessed.
title: Stealth assessment

description: The article organizes simulator development within the ESU/Standardisation in Surgical Education (SISE) framework as a stepwise evaluation program.
title: Stepwise ESU/SISE validation framework for surgical simulators

description: SCR is a complementary bias metric the article introduces because existing benchmarks \"probe model-internal associations via templated inputs and cover only broad occupational categories\", which does not suit free-text career recommendations.
title: Stereotype Congruence Rate (SCR)

description: The study used a stimulated recall procedure in which students' thinking processes during the tutorial group discussion were tapped, producing recall protocols analysed alongside verbatim transcripts of the group's verbal interaction.
title: Stimulated recall procedure for eliciting learner thinking

description: The article frames the storyboards produced as \"virtual data\" captured from thought experiments about imagined learning tasks.
title: Storyboards as virtual data from thought experiments

description: A stealth assessment framework that derives temporal evidence from students' dynamic in-game strategy use rather than only from ECD evidence modeling.
title: Strategy-based temporal analytics framework for stealth assessment using LSTM evidence models

description: To support generalization, the researchers conducted a cluster analysis on all 112 eligible community college sites based on college-level characteristics possibly related to student learning (e.g., average student age, proportion of adjunct faculty), yielding five clusters.
title: Stratified cluster-analysis site-selection method for improving generalization from experiments

description: The article proposes a repeatable mixed-methods pipeline that \"combines text mining to pre-sort the open-ended feedback\" with thematic analysis and multilevel modelling.
title: Streamlined four-step process for systematic analysis of written student feedback

description: The article uses the Strigel and Pouezevara (2012) framework of \"Variations on Mobile Learning Configurations\", which attends to three spectrums: a learning spectrum from formal to informal, a kinetic spectrum from stationary to mobile, and a collaborative spectrum from individual to group work.
title: Strigel and Pouezevara framework of mobile learning configurations, extended with access/affordability and mathematical pedagogy spectrums

description: Structural assessment is defined as measuring the learners' knowledge organization and comparing this with a referent structure.
title: Structural assessment

description: The article presents a methodological account of how \"performance differences can emerge in dual-language contexts where instructional methods and language tracks are structurally confounded.\" When cohort membership, instructional language, and instructional sequence are not independent, observed co
title: Structural confounding framework for dual-language cohort comparisons

description: The article applies a structural topic model (STM) to the abstracts and titles of 2,568 metacognition articles, running 26 candidate models with topic numbers from 5 to 30 and selecting the 19-topic model based on semantic coherence, exclusivity (FREX), and expert verification.
title: Structural topic modeling (STM) for educational research

description: A Student Digital Twin is defined as \"a continuously evolving model of an individual learner's academic performance, learning behavior, career interests, degree progression, financial circumstances, co-curricular engagement, and workforce preparedness.\" Its purpose is \"to simulate\": answering counte
title: Student Digital Twin

description: This feature extends Galyardt and Goldin's KC-level proportional decay measure by tracking the recency-weighted proportion of correct responses at the level of the student across KCs.
title: Student-level recency-weighted proportional correctness feature (RKC,SPFA)

description: The Student Momentum Indicator is a grounded-theory metric defined as \"the percent of students enrolled in the course who finished\", calculated after each lesson as M = (total enrolled - dropouts remaining after the lesson) / total enrolled.
title: Student Momentum Indicator
